a.lede: Suspected North Korean attackers duped an engineer with a fake job interview and a malicious download to gain a foothold in the crypto firm’s system and steal billions, according to Binance.
a.title: Binance Says Hackers Used Well-Known Tricks to Carry Out a $6.34 Billion Heist

b.lede: Techniques included laptop infections, compromised internal tooling, and fake job interviews.
b.title: Binance says hackers who stole billions in crypto spent months planning heist
